description: Read one workspace's saved giveaway config. targetMeanUsd is a budget on the band-midpoint estimate of the tier table, not the average value of the cards given. The top band's maxUsd must reach maxDrawUsd for cards near maxDrawUsd to be drawable. targetMeanUsd must stay below the per-channel marketplace price floor, or every roll refuses with target_not_below_ceiling.
